problem: The sentence 'A list can grow at its right end and shrink from either end' reads as if a list can only grow at the right end. That contradicts the later trap about insert(0, x), which grows the list at the left end (at O(n) cost). A student may take away the wrong rule.
fix: Say that a list grows cheaply at its right end with append, and that removing from either end is supported (pop() at the right, pop(0) at the left, the left one costing O(n)).
